issues.issue: The source is mixed or unstated. The Statement of Activities (p2-3) splits it into operating grants 152,762 and capital grants 210,890 without saying whether they are governmental, federal or private. The detail grants lines carry the same assumption.

The printed label is 'Community development', not community betterment. The Statement of Activities combines it as 'Economic and community development', so economic development may fit better. The keno-fund part (10,101) is plausibly community betterment, but the Grants Fund 41,943 (detail[162]) and the Community Development Fund 12 (detail[148]) are less clearly so.
No disbursement category exists for airports. 'other' with review is defensible, but it is a large governmental function (also the Airport department detail lines on p18).

issues.on_page: Fire: Transfers in 50,000; Administrative: Transfers out (475,203)
issues.issue: The 50,000 transfer into Fire is internal to the General Fund (the departmental total shows 50,000 in and 491,203 out, net 441,203, which matches the governmental funds statement's General Fund transfers out of 441,203 with no transfers in). The detail correctly carries both gross; the net ties.
